name: DesignCap
description_en:
DesignCap is a browser-based graphic design tool for posters, social graphics, presentations, infographics and reports. Users adapt templates with images, text, icons, grouped modules and charts, then save the editable design in an account and export or print a deliverable. It is a template-design workflow rather than a general data-analysis system.

The free plan limits uploads, saved designs and output formats. Paid Basic and Plus increase those limits and add high-resolution PNG/PDF; font upload is specifically listed for Plus in the FAQ. A design’s asset rights, editable cloud project and exported file require separate checks.
description_zh:
DesignCap是用于海报、社交图、演示、信息图及报告的浏览器设计工具，可用图片、文字、图标、组合模块和图表修改模板，再将可编辑设计存入账户并导出/打印。它是模板设计流程，不是通用数据分析系统。

免费版限制上传数、保存设计及输出格式，Basic和Plus增加额度及高分辨率PNG/PDF，FAQ特别在Plus列字体上传。资产权利、可编辑云项目及导出文件应分别检查。

core_features.explanation_en: Customize templates or a blank page with image/text/icon components and grouped modules that can be ungrouped for editing.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可用图像/文字/图标及组合模块修改模板或空白页，模块可取消分组后编辑。

core_features.explanation_en: Add line, column, bar, pie or area charts and edit/import data; this does not validate the source dataset or establish a live connection.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可添加折线、柱、条、饼或面积图并编辑/导入数据，但不校验源数据或建立实时连接。

core_features.explanation_en: Free lists JPG and 5 saved designs; paid plans add PNG/PDF and 100 or 1,000 saved-design allowances.
core_features.explanation_zh: 免费版列JPG及5个设计，付费增加PNG/PDF及100或1,000设计额度。

pricing.summary_en: Free 5 uploads/5 designs/JPG.Paid FAQ monthly USD 8.99 Basic/12.99 Plus; liveannualviewmonthly-equivalent 4.99/5.99, total 59.88/71.88 USD yearly.No lifetimeplan; tax/currentcheckout/renewalunverified.
pricing.summary_zh: 免费5上传/5设计/JPG。FAQ列月付Basic USD8.99、Plus12.99，实时年付月均4.99/5.99，全年USD59.88/71.88；无终身版，税/当前结账/续费未核。

sections.title_en: Customize a template and retain the editable project
sections.title_zh: 修改模板，并保留可编辑项目
sections.en:
For an illustrative event poster, choose a suitable template or blank page, upload approved photos, replace the title/date and adjust the background. The detailed tutorial describes image crop, opacity/color adjustments, alignment and stacking; modules can be ungrouped to change individual elements and grouped again. Save to the account before downloading the delivery file. No poster was created here.

The tutorial distinguishes Save/My Designs from Download, where the user chooses JPG/PNG/PDF and a size preset. The plan determines which outputs are available. An exported bitmap does not replace the editable cloud design, and the FAQ warns that manually deleting a project removes it from the account. Keep needed originals and exports before deleting or closing a workflow.
sections.zh:
例如活动海报，可选模板或空白页、上传获准照片、替换标题/日期并调背景。详细教程描述裁图、透明度/颜色调整、对齐及堆叠，模块可取消分组改单个元素后重新分组；下载交付文件前先存账户。本次未制作海报。

教程区分Save/My Designs与Download，后者选JPG/PNG/PDF及尺寸预设，可用输出取决于套餐。位图输出不替代云端可编辑设计，FAQ也提醒手工删除项目会从账户移除；删除或结束流程前应保留所需原件及输出。

sections.title_en: Verify the numbers independently of the chart styling
sections.title_zh: 图表样式之外独立核对数字
sections.en:
The chart section offers line, column, bar, pie and area styles and a data editor with file import. It lists CSV and a duplicated XLS extension in the instructions; the exact spreadsheet variants and parsing behavior were not tested. Treat that as a documented import option, not a verified XLSX/live-spreadsheet integration.

For a simple quarterly comparison, check labels, units, missing values and totals in the source first, then enter/import a small table and inspect the rendered chart. Modules for timelines, comparisons or SWOTare design building blocks, not automatic analysis. No spreadsheet, chart calculation or data-refresh behavior was executed.
sections.zh:
图表部分提供折线、柱、条、饼及面积样式，还有数据编辑及文件导入；说明列CSV和重复的XLS扩展，本次未测试确切表格变体及解析行为。因此只确认有文档导入选项，不能当作已验证XLSX/实时表格集成。

季度比较应先在源数据检查标签、单位、缺失值及总额，再输入/导入小表并检查渲染。时间线、比较、SWOT模块是设计组件，不自动做分析。本次未执行表格、图表计算或数据刷新。

sections.title_en: Compare the actual saved-design and upload caps
sections.title_zh: 比较实际设计及上传上限
sections.en:
The live browser pricing table confirms Free with 5 image uploads, up to 5 saved designs and JPG export; Basic with 100 uploads/100 designs; Plus with 1,000 uploads/1,000 designs. Both paid tiers list template/icon/module access and high-resolution PNG/PDF. The FAQ adds font upload to Plus. A claim of unlimited templates does not remove upload or project caps.

Annual pricing displays Basic USD 4.99/month with 59.88 billed yearly, and Plus USD 5.99 with 71.88 yearly. The FAQ lists monthly Basic 8.99 and Plus 12.99 USD and says no lifetime plan. Confirm tax, current monthly checkout and renewal before purchase; the generic 50%-saving headline is not a precise uniform discount for every displayed combination. Free resources can export without a watermark, while using premium assets can introduce a watermark until subscribed.
sections.zh:
实时浏览器价格表确认Free5上传、最多5设计及JPG；Basic100上传/100设计，Plus1,000上传/1,000设计。两付费档列模板/图标/模块及高分辨率PNG/PDF，FAQ另在Plus列字体上传。模板无限不免除上传及项目上限。

年付显示Basic月均USD4.99、全年59.88，Plus月均USD5.99、全年71.88；FAQ列月付Basic USD8.99、Plus12.99，且无终身方案。购买前需确认税、当前月付结账及续费；通用省50%宣传不是所有组合的精确统一折扣。免费素材可无水印输出，使用高级资产则可能产生水印，需订阅移除。

sections.title_en: Plan a downgrade around the billing cycle
sections.en:
The FAQ describes automatic renewal and cancellation that stops the next charge while preserving the paid plan to the end of its period. It describes manually upgrading with credit for unused days, but no direct downgrade:cancel first, wait for the current plan to end, then subscribe to the desired plan. It advertises a 7-day money-back guarantee, whose actual account eligibility and processing were not tested.

Do not assume cancellation immediately refunds a payment or that all over-limit projects/paid assets remain usable after returning to Free. Confirm retrieval, project retention and output rights before changing a working account. No payment, subscription change, refund or recovery was performed.
sections.zh:
FAQ描述自动续费，取消后停止下次扣款、付费权益保留到本期末；手工升级可抵未用天数，但不能直接降级，需先取消、等当前期结束后订所需档。页面宣传7天退款保证，本次未测试实际账户资格及处理。

不能假定取消立即退款，或回Free后超限项目/付费资产全部继续可用。变更工作账户前需确认取回、项目保留及输出权利，本次未付款、改订阅、退款或恢复。

sections.title_en: Check the assets and final print requirements
sections.title_zh: 核对资产及最终印刷要求
sections.en:
The FAQ permits commercial use of provided resources while making the user responsible for uploaded content rights. That is a resource-use statement, not proof of exclusivity, trademark clearance or an open-source application license. Search results for images/icons and uploaded fonts still need their applicable terms checked. Detailed redistribution/template-resale rights were not established.

DesignCap is plausible for quick branded documents and social/event graphics where the plan’s output quality is sufficient. Pro fessional prepress, color profiles, bleed and an editable source handoff to another application need separate checks; the documented home-printer command is not proof of press readiness. The help also cites old browser/social-platform versions, so current integration compatibility should be verified rather than inferred.
sections.zh:
FAQ允许提供资源商用，同时要求用户负责上传内容权利。这是资源使用声明，不证明独占、商标清理或应用开源；搜索所得图像/图标和上传字体仍需核对条款，本次未建立细致再分发/模板转售权。

若套餐输出质量足够，DesignCap可用于快速品牌文档及社交/活动图。专业印前、色彩配置、出血及交给其他应用的可编辑源稿需另查，家用打印命令不证明印厂就绪。帮助还引用旧浏览器/社交平台版本，因此当前集成兼容需验证。
